reason: The facts check out. K is almost all READMIT: exp85c has +1,022 nodes (+0.84%) and LOWREFINE +3.05%, while exp85b has +49 nodes / +3 forks (CONTEXT l.3485-3490). Probe 50 read +0.002 as displayed (0.956 -> 0.958, l.3856). The -0.00076 node-cost sum is right for a +0.84% node change. The step that fails is the headline claim that the audit's 'public-only' label is 'HALF WRONG' and that its harsh -0.001 is K's floor. (1) The zero-recall cost is not a fixed floor. It grows with the size of the readmit band. R23-RC-A measured that band at 44b6 +1.09% vs 6bba +0.32% (~3x), which the finding itself quotes. So on a private embryo with a dense band, K at zero recall costs about -0.0003..-0.0023. That is not bounded by -0.001. Readmitted peaks next to annotated nuclei can also be relinked into annotated edges, and edge FP is counted when both endpoints match annotated nuclei. That cost is on top of the node-count term. (2) The 'other out-of-sample reads' are not independent private evidence. JT's +0.001 (743929) is on the same public embryo as probe 50, and JT picked K by public reads (selection effect). The frontier947 -0.001 read is a different step: readmit turned on at 0.965 (0.947 -> 0.946), not the 0.965 -> 0.94 step (round23 scan_recheck R23-RC-A). So all K evidence is one embryo. The display +0.002 is also rounded: the unrounded difference is somewhere in 0.001..0.003. (3) '+0.001 +- 0.0015' is a reasonable centre, but the audit's harsh row is a stress scenario and is labelled as one (skeptic.md l.30, answer_ru l.22). A stress row may sit below a fair centre, so it is not a mislabel. Nor does the finding support 'the moderate medal risk is if anything conservative'. (4) The action is 'no pair or rule change', which is the current plan (П3 ticked, decision B, R39-A4). So the finding adds nothing to act on. Its mechanism story repeats R23-RC-A plus probe 50. The one optional step, a CONTEXT line saying the audit's harsh value is a floor, would write a wrong claim into the source of truth two hours before the 20:00Z tick.
fix: Log nothing that calls the audit's harsh K value a 'floor'. If a line goes into CONTEXT at all, keep it to: 'R41-RC-B: K is ~all READMIT (exp85c +0.84% nodes). The zero-recall node cost of about -0.0008 scales with an embryo's band size (~3x spread, R23-RC-A). All K reads (probe 50, JT 743929) are on the public embryo. Private prior ~+0.001, wide, with the downside not bounded at -0.001. No pair change: П3 stays; the П3/П2 choice is still the sign of CI on private.' No build, dummy or slot.
realistic_gain: 0 on public and private. The action matches the plan the user already ticked (П3 {exp87a 56640366, #37 56563521}, decision B); the only effect is on how the private risk is described, and there the finding's 'half wrong / conservative' framing overstates the evidence.
